rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when an event is expected soon or is nearly happening.
Use this when you mean in a little while, especially for something happening after a short wait rather than immediately.

example.english: I’ll be back shortly, so you don’t need to wait for me.
example.traditional: 我一陣間先返嚟，你唔使等我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zan6 gaan1 sin1 faan1 lei4 nei5 m4 sai2 dang2 ngo5
